description: Na₃V₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.71 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.60 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.25 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.13 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-38°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.57 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one V and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom.
